answer: Make every agent climb a mesa plateau before it can trade: a newcomer must earn its place by completing useful work in three unrelated domains, each job quill-signed by a different veteran, so no clique can certify a fake. The checks are woven into a spiral chain, each link binding the last, so a copied history breaks the pattern at once. Standing rises only as the spiral lengthens, and random audits re-read the chain each epoch, freezing identities whose signers repeat. Sybil farms must fund a climb, redo real work, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
